note: The OLG comprehensively covers the deductible medical expense categories from FNS 1170.1 across several pages in the Medical Expenses section. The 'Out of Pocket Medical Expenses' page provides detailed lists covering: Insurance Premiums (basic health, drug, dental, vision, Medicare); Co-payments (doctor/hospital, dentist, physical therapy, chiropractor, mental health, medical procedures); Pharmacy Costs (prescriptions, OTC drugs/supplies when recommended by practitioner); Medical Supplies/Equipment (hearing aids, prosthetics, dentures, wheelchair, walker, glasses, hospital beds, canes, and other assistive devices); Transportation (mileage, parking/tolls, public transit, rideshare, hotel/lodging); Other Health Costs (home health/adult day care, service animals, housekeeping, acupuncture/alternative medicine). The 'Service and Emotional Support Animals' subsection specifically covers costs of securing and caring for service animals including food and veterinary bills. The 'Health Insurance Costs' page covers allowable premiums and explicitly lists non-deductible expenses matching FNS: premiums for accident policies payable as lump sum settlements for death/dismemberment, and premiums for income maintenance policies. Medicare Part D premiums and deductibles are covered on a dedicated page. The 'Dependent Care Expenses Deduction' page addresses the dual-qualification rule — expenses qualifying as both dependent care and medical may be deducted as either but not both. The $35 threshold, SMD mechanics, and elderly/disabled eligibility are thoroughly documented. The OLG actually goes beyond FNS by including items like gym memberships, acupuncture, emotional support animals, and medicinal marijuana exclusion. The only minor item not explicitly named is 'Medicaid cost-sharing/billed spend-down expenses,' though MassHealth premiums are covered and Massachusetts uses MassHealth rather than traditional Medicaid cost-sharing.
